issues.display_title: Issue #1189: fix(map): typing coordinates zooms the location map out
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Found while filming the #1186 demo (2026-10-07). In the project location form, typing a latitude or longitude key by key leaves the map preview zoomed out, at about z9 instead of z16. Pasting a whole value works.

Where

ProjectLocationForm (src/components/projects/ProjectLocationForm.tsx) is the form behind:

  • Create New Empty Project;
  • Create a Blue Line Map project;
  • Clone as 3D Project;
  • Edit project information in the Blue Line Map editor (#1186).

It is the only MapLibreCore caller whose coordinates come from text inputs.

Repro

  1. Open any of the forms above. The map preview is at z16 on the pin.
  2. Click Latitude, select all, and type -6.5711546 at normal typing speed. Then do the same in Longitude with 107.7615836.
  3. The pin lands on the right place, but the map stays zoomed out to the region (Purwakarta to Cimahi in view), around z9.

Seen in an earlier take of the #1186 demo, typing at 60 ms per key: every frame from the last keystroke on stayed at about z9. That take was overwritten; the kept demo pastes the values instead.

Cause

Two things stack up.

  1. Every keystroke starts a new flyTo.
    • MapLibreCore.tsx:196-208 calls flyTo({ center, duration: 1000 }) whenever the lat/lng props move.
    • With no zoom given, flyTo targets the zoom the map has at that moment.
    • Its arc zooms out mid-flight. The next keystroke cuts it there, and the new flyTo keeps that zoomed-out level as its target.
    • So each key ratchets the zoom further out.
  2. A field that is briefly empty or invalid sends the map to Toronto.
    • ProjectLocationForm.tsx:225 passes parsedLat ?? DEFAULT_LOCATION.lat.
    • So while the field reads "" or -, the map is told to fly to Toronto's latitude, and the jump is huge.

Scope

  1. While a coordinate is being typed, the preview keeps its zoom (z16, or whatever the user zoomed to) and ends centred on the final value.
  2. An empty or invalid coordinate leaves the map where it is. It no longer flies to the default location.
  3. Dragging the map, picking an address, and pasting coordinates keep working as today.
  4. The other MapLibreCore callers keep their behaviour: the Preview overlay, the editor 3D map, the Blue Line Map, Apply Location and Floor Image Position.

Possible fixes, to choose while working:

  • keep the last valid coordinates in the form;
  • debounce what reaches the map;
  • and/or recenter with easeTo (no zoom-out arc), or pass an explicit zoom.

Acceptance criteria

  • Typing -6.5711546 / 107.7615836 key by key leaves the preview at the zoom it had, centred on that point.
  • Clearing a coordinate field does not move the map.
  • Map drag, address pick and paste still move the pin and the fields as today.
  • A test covers the typed sequence: intermediate values, including empty and -, do not change the zoom or jump to the default location.
  • The other MapLibreCore users are unchanged.

RESULT

video-1189-coordinate-zoom.mp4

Released to main in 822adaa7 (release PR #1191). The fix came in through PR #1190, merged to development as 042094d7; the fix commit is defe1903.

Typing a latitude or longitude key by key in the project location form now keeps the map preview's zoom and lands on the typed point. An empty or invalid field leaves the map where it is. The form backs New Empty Project, New Blue Line Map project, Clone as 3D and Edit project information.

Fix

  • src/components/map/MapLibreCore.tsx: flightZoomRef holds the zoom of the flight in the air.
    • A recenter that cuts a flight keeps that zoom instead of the zoomed-out middle of the arc.
    • moveend clears the ref, when a flight lands or when the user moves the map.
    • The ref is set after flyTo, because flyTo's stop() fires the old flight's moveend synchronously.
    • A single flight is unchanged for every other map.
  • src/components/projects/ProjectLocationForm.tsx: the map keeps the last valid coordinates. Before, a field that was briefly "" or - sent it to latitude 43.65, the default location.

Tests

  • New MapLibreCore.test.tsx (4) and ProjectLocationForm.test.tsx (3).
  • Mutation check: dropping the ref, setting it before flyTo, not clearing it on moveend, and reverting the form each fail a test.
  • pnpm test (2956), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked in real Chrome

  • .playwright-mcp/demo/1189/check-coordinate-zoom.mjs, 5/5:
    • development goes from z16 to z9.2 after typing, and clearing the latitude moves the map to lat 43.65;
    • with the fix the map stays at z16, and clearing does not move it.
  • Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1189/video-1189-coordinate-zoom.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1194: Wizard resumes a draft whose project was deleted, so floor plan uploads fail with 404
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1192 (2026-10-08). Floor plan uploads in the Create New Tour wizard fail with "upload failed (HTTP 404)". The user cannot get past the Floors step, and starting a new project again does not help.

What the video shows

On prod map-thru.com/start:

  1. New Project → Scan a floor plan. The wizard does not start fresh: it resumes an old draft on the Order step ("GoThru Tegal", no floors).
  2. The user goes back to Location, presses Confirm Location, and uploads two PNGs.
  3. Both POST /api/upload calls answer 404.

Cause

The draft outlives its project.

  • The API deletes abandoned projects. src/jobs/cleanup_incomplete_projects.go in the API repo runs every hour and soft-deletes every project with is_complete = false created more than 24 hours ago.
  • The draft keeps the project id. The wizard's draft (localStorage gothru_wizard) holds projectId and lives as long as the gs_session cookie (30 days). On resume (useWizardPersistence, wizard branch) nobody checks that the project still exists.
  • Confirm Location reuses the dead id. confirmLocationAndProject (src/lib/projects/wizardProject.ts) keeps any projectId already in the store. Uploads then go to POST /v1/projects/<deleted id>/file, which answers 404 project not found.
  • Prod data matches. Project a238834c… "GoThru Tegal" was created 2026-10-01 08:33, never completed, and deleted 2026-10-02 09:06 (read-only check).

A second problem hides the API's message. /api/upload passes the API's error body through as is: { statusCode, requestTime, data: { error } }. Every caller reads .error at the top level, so the user only ever sees the generic text. That covers the wizard, Add Level, Event photos and the editor image upload.

Scope

  1. When the wizard resumes a draft that carries a projectId, it checks that project.
    • If the API answers 404 (deleted) or 403 (not this account's), the draft starts over. It keeps the project name and the location, and opens on Location, so Confirm Location creates a new project.
    • The uploaded files and floors are dropped too: they were stored under the dead project and cannot be read back.
  2. A network error or a 5xx keeps the draft as it is, so an outage never throws work away.
  3. /api/upload reads the error from the API's data envelope, so callers show the API's own message ("project not found", the owner-only 403 text).
  4. Unchanged:
    • a draft whose project still exists;
    • the editor's own project load;
    • the 24-hour cleanup job in the API.

Acceptance criteria

  • Resuming a draft whose project answers 404 opens the wizard on Location with the name and location kept and no project id. Confirm Location creates a new project, and uploads succeed.
  • The same happens for a 403.
  • A failed check (network error, 5xx) leaves the draft untouched.
  • A draft whose project exists resumes exactly as today.
  • An upload error from the API shows its own message instead of "upload failed (HTTP 404)".
  • Tests cover the three resume outcomes and the error unwrapping.

RESULT

video-1194-deleted-draft.mp4

Released to main in 21986952 (release PR #1196). The fix came in through PR #1195, merged to development as 74fbfc5b; the fix commit is 8c0a9440. Deploy succeeded.

A wizard draft whose project was deleted no longer traps the user. On resume the wizard checks the draft's project.

  • 404 or 403: the draft starts over on Location, with the project name and location kept. Its uploads and floors are dropped, since they lived under the deleted project. Confirm Location then creates a new project.
  • Any other failure (5xx, network) leaves the draft as it is.

Upload errors now show the API's own message. For example, "project not found" instead of "upload failed (HTTP 404)".

Fix

  • src/actions/projects.ts and src/lib/projects/projectActionResult.ts: getProject failures carry the HTTP status.
  • src/hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts: the wizard's project check starts the draft over on a 404 or 403. Before, every failure read "Project not found", so the draft was never dropped.
  • src/app/api/upload/route.ts: hands back the payload inside the API's data envelope. This covers the wizard, Add Level, Event photos and editor image uploads.

Tests

  • New useWizardPersistence.deletedDraft.test.tsx (5), plus new cases in projects.test.ts and route.test.ts.
  • Mutation check: 6 of 6 caught.
  • pnpm test (2965), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked

  • Real Chrome (.playwright-mcp/demo/1194/check-deleted-draft.mjs), development against the fix: 11/11.
  • Production map-thru.com after the deploy: 7/7.
    • The draft on a deleted project starts over on Location, with the name kept and no id.
    • Confirm Location creates a new project, and the upload lands in it.
    • A failing upload shows "project not found".
  • Scratch projects only; every one was deleted.
  • Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1194/video-1194-deleted-draft.mp4.

Not covered: a wizard tab left open for more than 24 hours without a reload. Uploads there still fail, but now with "project not found".

issues.display_title: Issue #1197: Step 3: show the floor plan image's move, resize and rotate markers without a click
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1193 (2026-10-08). In Step 3 (Floor Order & Heights), the floor plan image on the map gives no sign that it can be moved, resized or rotated. The request asks for box markers around the image.

What exists

The markers are already built (#1128 / #1129). They show only while the image is selected.

  • FloorImageOverlay (src/components/map/FloorImageOverlay.tsx) draws:
    • a dashed box;
    • four corner resize handles;
    • a rotate knob above the top edge (Shift snaps to 15°).
  • Clicking the image selects it, and clicking the map elsewhere deselects it.
  • The Add Floor and Edit Floor position modals (FloorImagePositionModal) pass defaultSelected, so the markers are there from the start.
  • Step 3 (WizardFloorImage, src/components/setup/step-list-floor/WizardFloorImage.tsx) does not. Until the user happens to click the image, it looks like a flat picture, and hovering it does not even change the cursor.

PRD #1125 says "When the image is selected, the user can adjust position, size and rotation". So today's behaviour follows the PRD; this request makes the affordance visible.

Scope

  1. In Step 3, the shown floor's image starts selected: the box, corner handles and rotate knob are visible as soon as it appears, as in the modals.
    • Switching to another floor, or hiding and showing it with the eye icon, shows it selected again.
  2. Once deselected (a click on the map outside it), hovering the image shows a pointer cursor, so it still reads as clickable. A click selects it again, as today.
  3. Unchanged:
    • moving, resizing and rotating;
    • where the position is saved (the floor config, right away);
    • the modals' behaviour;
    • dragging the map outside the image.

While the image is selected, a drag that starts on it moves the image rather than the map. This is how the modals already behave.

Acceptance criteria

  • Opening Step 3 with an uploaded floor shows its image with the dashed box, four corner handles and the rotate knob, without a click.
  • Selecting another floor, or hiding and showing the image, shows the markers again.
  • After a click outside the image, hovering it shows a pointer cursor, and a click brings the markers back.
  • Move, resize and rotate still save to the floor config.
  • Tests cover the default-selected Step 3 image and the hover cursor.

RESULT

Released to main in 2bec0f34 (release PR #1199). The change came in through PR #1198, merged to development as e37cf383; the commit is 55782399. Deploy succeeded.

In Step 3 (Floor Order & Heights), the floor plan image now shows its dashed box, four corner handles and rotate knob as soon as it appears, without a click. This matches the Add Floor and Edit Floor modals.

  • Another floor, or hiding and showing the image with the eye icon, brings it back selected.
  • Once deselected, hovering the image shows a pointer, and a click selects it again.
  • Moving, resizing, rotating and saving to the floor config are unchanged.

Change

  • src/components/setup/step-list-floor/WizardFloorImage.tsx: passes defaultSelected to the overlay. The overlay is keyed by floor.
  • src/components/map/FloorImageOverlay.tsx: the hover cursor is pointer over an unselected image and move over a selected one.

Tests

  • floorImageStep3.test.tsx (+1) and FloorImageOverlay.test.tsx (+1).
  • Mutation check: 3 of 3 caught.
  • pnpm test (2967), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked

  • Real Chrome (.playwright-mcp/demo/1197/check-step3-markers.mjs), development against the fix: 7/7.
  • Production map-thru.com after the deploy: 6/6.
    • The markers show without a click.
    • A click outside deselects, and hover shows a pointer.
    • A click brings the markers back, and a drag still saves the position.
  • Real uploads on scratch projects, every one deleted.
  • Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1197/video-1197-step3-markers.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1201: Editor Map layer menu: one choice of Street, Satellite or 3D Building
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1200 (2026-10-08). The editor's Map layer menu (bottom toolbar, Map tab) should be single select. Today it can show two ticks at once: "Street Map Filter ✓" and "3D Building ✓".

What exists

src/components/editor/toolbar/MapMenuButton.tsx (#197):

  • Street Map Filter and Satellite Map Filter set mapStyle (vector / satellite). They already exclude each other.
  • 3D Building flips building3DVisible on its own, under a separator. So it is ticked alongside either basemap.
  • The satellite style has no 3D buildings. SATELLITE_STYLE is one raster layer; only the street (vector) style has building-3d. So Satellite + 3D Building is a tick that does nothing.

The Blue Line Map already offers these as one choice. MapDisplaySwitch has Street Map / Satellite Map / 3D Building, and TourLinesMap shows the extruded buildings only for 3D Building.

Scope

  1. The menu is one choice of three, with exactly one ticked:

    Choice Basemap 3D buildings
    Street Map Filter street (vector) off
    Satellite Map Filter satellite off
    3D Building street (vector) on

  2. It maps onto the existing state (mapStyle + building3DVisible); no new store field.

    • A stored satellite + 3D combination reads as Satellite.
    • Picking a choice closes the menu.

  3. The separator goes, since the three are one group.

  4. Unchanged:

    • how each basemap and the building extrusion render;
    • every other map: Blue Line, the wizard, the modals.

Acceptance criteria

  • The menu never shows more than one tick.
  • Street Map Filter: street basemap, no 3D buildings.
  • Satellite Map Filter: satellite basemap, no 3D buildings.
  • 3D Building: street basemap with 3D buildings, from either other choice.
  • A test covers the three choices and the tick, including the old satellite + 3D state.

RESULT

video-1201-map-layer.mp4

Released to main in 54af2cc2 (release PR #1203). The change came in through PR #1202, merged to development as abbd8130; the commit is 1ba2424d. Deploy succeeded.

The editor's Map layer menu is now one choice, as on the Blue Line Map. Exactly one is ticked, and a pick closes the menu.

Choice Basemap 3D buildings
Street Map Filter street off
Satellite Map Filter satellite off
3D Building street on

A stored satellite + 3D pair reads as Satellite.

Change

  • src/components/editor/toolbar/MapMenuButton.tsx:
    • the choice is derived from the existing mapStyle + building3DVisible, with the MapDisplay type shared with MapDisplaySwitch;
    • each pick sets both and closes the menu;
    • the separator is gone.

Tests

  • New src/components/editor/toolbar/__tests__/MapMenuButton.test.tsx (4).
  • Mutation check: 4 of 4 caught.
  • pnpm test (2971), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked

  • Real Chrome (.playwright-mcp/demo/1201/check-map-layer.mjs), development against the fix: 6/6. The map state is read from MapLibre.
  • Production map-thru.com after the deploy: 4/4.
    • 3D Building gives the street map with 3D buildings, as the only tick.
    • Satellite gives the satellite map, as the only tick.
    • Street gives the street map with no 3D buildings, as the only tick.
  • Scratch projects only; every one was deleted.
  • Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1201/video-1201-map-layer.mp4.

Noticed, not changed (already on development): on a project with no floors, at a 900 px tall window, the "No floors yet" card covers the toolbar's dropdown menus.
